vision.paraphrase: Drawing the month's spending as a chart is the fifth goal.

conops.paraphrase: chart writes the HTML file the user named.

vision.paraphrase: A chart the user can read needs each bar named and valued.

conops.paraphrase: Each bar is labelled with the category and its total.

vision.paraphrase: Local and private: the chart loads nothing from anywhere else.

conops.paraphrase: The page opens in a browser from the local file alone.

requirements.rationale: Whether a picture is readable cannot be asserted by a test; a person opens the page and looks.

vision.paraphrase: The chart is for a person to look at, so a person judges whether it reads well.

conops.paraphrase: Bars are tall in proportion to the money spent, with nothing overlapping.
